## About
D & L Auto Shop started small, with childhood friends who shared a passion for cars leasing a little building to fix cars for family and friends. Word of mouth grew it into a full time shop with new equipment and a larger space.
Our goal is simple: quality auto repair at a fair price. We offer bumper-to-bumper service, from oil changes and brakes to diagnosing the most complex drivability problems, whether your vehicle is high performance or more conservative.
We want to be the neighborhood shop for Duncanville, Desoto, Cedar Hill, Lancaster and the rest of the area. Our neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 93 Google reviews, and many of them mention Sean and Debbie by name.

## Services
- Brake diagnosis and repair: If your car pulls when you brake or the pedal doesn't feel right, bring it in.
- Wheel alignment, steering and suspension: Alignment, front end work, power steering and suspension repair.
- Electrical diagnostics and repair: Tracking down electrical problems and fixing them.
- Oil change and lube service: Oil and lube service plus routine maintenance that keeps your car running.
- Exhaust systems: Exhaust system service and repair.
- Van and truck fleet service: Repair and service for business fleets.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 1411 S. Alexander Ave. in Duncanville.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: I found a red spot under my car. What does that mean?
A: A red oily spot usually points to a transmission or power steering fluid leak. Bring it by and we'll take a look.
